title: Transfer: model a part

blocks.md:
## An object graph that matches a world part

Build `{ id, type, props }` like `world-v1`. `makePart("fox", { x: 1, y: 0 })` returns that shape. `movePart(part, "east")` increments `props.x`.

Print `2` after two easts from x=0.

choices.md: An object the engine can read (`x`, `y`…)

blocks.promptMd: > `makePart` + `movePart` east twice from x=0. Print the new x (`2`).

description: Model a part as an object with the same rules you just learned.
